title: Why does AI think 9.11 is bigger than 9.9? 🤖

beats.say: Why do some AIs think nine point one one is bigger than nine point nine?
Researchers at Transluce watched Meta's Llama model compare decimals.
It got just fifty five percent right. Basically a coin flip.
And some neurons lighting up? Bible verses.

beats.sub: one theory: 9.11 reads like a verse
beats.say: One theory: it reads nine eleven like chapter nine, verse eleven. Which comes after verse eight.
Switch off five hundred Bible neurons, and accuracy jumps from fifty five to seventy six percent.
Dates and software versions confuse it too. There, nine eleven really is newer.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
